title: A universal group of type F∞
summary: We construct a single group of type F ∞ containing every finitely presented group. Its finitely generated subgroups, up to isomorphism, are exactly the finitely generated recursively presented groups. This answers the F ∞ form of the higher-dimensional Higman embedding question.

review.reason: Constructs a type F-infinity group containing every finitely presented group.
